response.overview: A magical evening hosted by Lance Bass and featuring performances by Nicole Scherzinger, Jason Mraz, Mark Ambor, Jamie Miller, “O” by Cirque du Soleil, JYT, American Authors, Kenedi Anderson and more. Delight in the lighting of the Christmas Tree, the season’s first snowfall, an exciting drone show, a fireworks spectacular and Santa Claus’ grand arrival.
response.title: 25th Annual Grove Tree Lighting Celebration
